$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. PackageFixtureRecord = one entry under a .floop package's fixtures/ directory (floop-container-format.v1.json requiredTopLevelLayout: 'keyed per fixture-keying.v1 (nodeId, iterationIndex, callIndex) — NOT tests/fixtures/'). Keying resolved at LOOP_WEB_STUDIO_SPEC.md §6 (10_DUAL_VALIDATION_ADDENDUM.md §D 'Fixture keying is unspecified'): keying by node ID alone breaks on retries, by ordinal alone breaks on branch changes, by prompt hash alone breaks on every prompt edit — hence the three-part key plus a recorded-but-non-binding prompt digest.
title: PackageFixtureRecord
description: A single recorded simulation/replay/fault-injection fixture, keyed on (nodeId, iterationIndex, callIndex). Feeds LOOP-TEST-001 (a node with no required fixture and no explicit test-coverage declaration is a build finding) and LOOP-TEST-002 (a fixture whose recorded prompt digest no longer matches the node's current prompt is STALE, a WARNING, never a silent miss or silent wrong-match).

nodeId.description: Stable node ID this fixture replays for (FB-RAT-PKG-009 — node IDs are stable across surfaces, canonicalization, import, export, and semantic-preserving layout changes).

iterationIndex.description: Which iteration of a repeat group / loop cycle this recording is for (0-based). Distinguishes fixtures on nodes inside a bounded cycle (LOOP-GRAPH-004) from a single fixture silently reused across every pass.

callIndex.description: Which call within a single node visit this recording is for (0-based) — a node may invoke its underlying model/tool more than once per visit (e.g. retry-with-backoff); callIndex disambiguates which attempt this fixture replays.

recordedPromptDigest.description: Digest of the model/tool-directed prompt text in effect when this fixture was recorded. NON-BINDING: carried alongside the (nodeId, iterationIndex, callIndex) key, never as part of it. Null for node categories with no prompt text to digest (e.g. a deterministic or typed-tool node). A mismatch against the node's CURRENT prompt digest at validation time marks this fixture STALE (LOOP-TEST-002) — a visible WARNING finding, never a silent miss and never a silent match against the wrong prompt.

recordedOutput.description: The recorded/mocked output value this fixture replays for a model-inference, typed-tool, verifier, or artifact-import/export node — shape is whatever that node's own declared output schema (schemas/ in the package) requires; NOT independently constrained by this schema, which only knows this is 'some JSON value or null'. Null when this fixture instead records a decision (see recordedDecision) rather than a value-typed output — see the sibling-field note below.

recordedDecision.description: The recorded human-decision-fixture outcome this fixture replays for a human-decision node (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1.md §8 test modes; LOOP_WEB_STUDIO_SPEC.md §6 'human-decision fixtures'). Null when this fixture instead records a value-typed output (see recordedOutput) rather than a decision.

stale.description: Advisory/cache field: whether the validator last found recordedPromptDigest to disagree with the node's current prompt digest (LOOP-TEST-002). Null when this record has not yet been checked against a live definition. recordedPromptDigest itself remains the source of truth — a consumer MUST NOT trust a cached `stale: false` without re-checking against the current definition; this field exists so a UI can render a badge without recomputing on every read, not as an independently authoritative fact.

recordedAtUtc.description: UTC instant this fixture was captured (FB-RAT-COM-004).

decisionValue.description: The recorded human choice this fixture replays — shape is whatever the node's declared decision schema requires.

decidedByFixtureAuthor.description: Who recorded this decision fixture, for audit only — never a claim about who would decide at real run time.
